inputs.name: Key
inputs.purpose: Component model key, e.g. "gen-park" or "load-power".

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.purpose: Dynamic parameters (table or string); NaN uses the class defaults. Default: nan.

inputs.name: P
inputs.purpose: [pu] Active power injection setting for the power flow (negative for a load). Default: 0.

inputs.name: Q
inputs.purpose: [pu] Reactive power injection setting; NaN makes the bus a PV bus. Default: 0.

inputs.name: baseMVA
inputs.purpose: [MVA] Rating of the component; shares Q among the components of a bus (not the system base). Default: 100.

inputs.name: Pmin
inputs.purpose: [pu] Lower limit of the active power output (-Inf: none). Default: -inf.

inputs.name: Pmax
inputs.purpose: [pu] Upper limit of the active power output (Inf: none). Default: inf.

inputs.name: Qmin
inputs.purpose: [pu] Lower limit of the reactive power output (-Inf: none). Default: -inf.

inputs.name: Qmax
inputs.purpose: [pu] Upper limit of the reactive power output (Inf: none). Default: inf.

inputs.name: OPFinit_P0
inputs.purpose: [pu] Initial active power of the OPF solver. Default: 0.

inputs.name: OPFinit_Q0
inputs.purpose: [pu] Initial reactive power of the OPF solver. Default: 0.

inputs.name: OPFcost_HP
inputs.purpose: Quadratic cost coefficient of P; NaN: class default (0 for loads, 1 otherwise). Default: nan.

inputs.name: OPFcost_HQ
inputs.purpose: Quadratic cost coefficient of Q (AC OPF). Default: 0.

inputs.name: OPFcost_fP
inputs.purpose: Linear cost coefficient of P; NaN: class default (0 for loads, 1 otherwise). Default: nan.

inputs.name: OPFcost_fQ
inputs.purpose: Linear cost coefficient of Q (AC OPF). Default: 0.

inputs.name: OPFcost_startup
inputs.purpose: Startup cost (reserved; unit commitment is not part of the OPF). Default: 0.

inputs.name: OPFcost_shutdown
inputs.purpose: Shutdown cost (reserved; unit commitment is not part of the OPF). Default: 0.

inputs.name: Xaxis
inputs.purpose: x coordinate in network diagrams (NaN = automatic layout). Default: nan.

inputs.name: Yaxis
inputs.purpose: y coordinate in network diagrams (NaN = automatic layout). Default: nan.

inputs.name: Marker
inputs.purpose: Marker of the component in network diagrams. Default: "o".

inputs.name: MidXaxis
inputs.purpose: x coordinates of intermediate points of the connection line in network diagrams. Default: "".

inputs.name: MidYaxis
inputs.purpose: y coordinates of intermediate points of the connection line in network diagrams. Default: "".

inputs.name: s_tag
inputs.purpose: Tag of the component to replace.

inputs.name: Key
inputs.purpose: Component model key, e.g. "gen-park" or "load-power".

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.purpose: Dynamic parameters (table or string); NaN uses the class defaults. Default: nan.

inputs.name: Controllers
inputs.purpose: Local controllers of the replaced component: "drop" leaves them on it with a warning, "keep" moves them to the new one. Default: "drop".

inputs.name: s_tag
inputs.purpose: Tag of the component to remove.

inputs.name: Key
inputs.purpose: Local controller model key, e.g. "avr-ST1" or "pss-PSS1".

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.purpose: Constructor parameters (struct or one-row table of Name=Value); omitted ones use the class defaults. Default: struct().

inputs.name: s_tag
inputs.purpose: Tag (s_tag) of the local controller to remove.

inputs.name: RemoveNested
inputs.purpose: Also remove the controller nested in the removed one (the PSS under an AVR). Default: false.

inputs.name: Key
inputs.purpose: Branch model key, e.g. "pi" or "pi_transformer".

inputs.name: from_to
inputs.purpose: End buses [from, to], as indices of a_Bus or as bus tags. Default: [1,2].

inputs.name: R
inputs.purpose: [pu] Series resistance. Default: 0.

inputs.name: X
inputs.purpose: [pu] Series reactance. Default: 1.

inputs.name: C
inputs.purpose: [pu] Shunt susceptance at each end (half of the line charging). Default: 0.

inputs.name: Tap
inputs.purpose: Off-nominal tap ratio (1 for a line). Default: 1.

inputs.name: Phase
inputs.purpose: [rad] Phase shift of the transformer. Default: 0/180*pi.

inputs.name: Smax
inputs.purpose: [pu] Limit of the apparent power at both ends (Inf: none). Default: inf.

inputs.name: Imax
inputs.purpose: [pu] Limit of the current at both ends (Inf: none). Default: inf.

inputs.name: Pmax
inputs.purpose: [pu] Limit of the active power at both ends (Inf: none). Default: inf.

inputs.name: Qmax
inputs.purpose: [pu] Limit of the reactive power at both ends (Inf: none). Default: inf.

inputs.name: Vargmax
inputs.purpose: [rad] Limit of the angle difference between the end buses (Inf: none). Default: 90/180*pi.

inputs.name: MidXaxis
inputs.purpose: x coordinates of intermediate points in network diagrams. Default: [].

inputs.name: MidYaxis
inputs.purpose: y coordinates of intermediate points in network diagrams. Default: [].

inputs.name: Marker
inputs.purpose: Line style of the branch in network diagrams. Default: "-".

inputs.name: Key
inputs.purpose: Global controller model key, e.g. "agc-PI".

inputs.name: a_Unit
inputs.purpose: Controlled components of this network: Component objects (cell array or one object) or tags.

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.purpose: Constructor parameters (struct or one-row table of Name=Value); omitted ones use the class defaults. Default: struct().

inputs.name: tag
inputs.purpose: Tags of the branches to remove.

inputs.name: sr_BusTag
inputs.purpose: Tags of the buses to remove.

inputs.name: RemoveBranches
inputs.purpose: Also remove the branches connected to the removed buses. Default: false.

inputs.name: sr_GconTag
inputs.purpose: Tags of the global controllers to remove.

inputs.name: s_tag
inputs.purpose: Tag of the new scenario; a number is added when a child of the network has it.

inputs.name: Time
inputs.purpose: [s] Simulation time [t0, tend]. Default: From.Time, else [0, 10].

inputs.name: Description
inputs.purpose: Free text. Default: From.Description, else "".

inputs.name: From
inputs.purpose: Scenario to copy the disturbances, Time and Description from (of this or another network).

outputs.name: sc
outputs.purpose: The new scenario, a child of the network.

inputs.name: sr_tag
inputs.purpose: Tags of the scenarios to remove.

inputs.name: s_scenario
inputs.purpose: Tag of the scenario to run (net.add_scenario).

inputs.name: Time
inputs.purpose: [s] Simulation time [t0, tend] of this call. Default: the Time of the scenario.

inputs.name: Solver
inputs.purpose: Solver of the MATLAB ode object. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: Tolerance
inputs.purpose: Relative error tolerance. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: AbsoluteTolerance
inputs.purpose: Absolute error tolerance. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: MaxStep
inputs.purpose: [s] Largest step of the solver; NaN for the solver default. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: InitialStep
inputs.purpose: [s] First step of each phase; NaN for the solver default. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: SeparateComplexParts
inputs.purpose: SeparateComplexParts of the ode object (true: "on", false: "off"). Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: TimeLimit
inputs.purpose: [s] Wall-clock limit of the whole run; Inf for none. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: Progress
inputs.purpose: "dialog", "disp" or "none" (true: "dialog", false: "none"). Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: Verbose
inputs.purpose: Print the phases and the outcome. Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: PlotFcn
inputs.purpose: Live display during the run: "none" (draw the result with result.plot_trajectory()). Default: GUILDA.setting.

inputs.name: Format
inputs.purpose: Form of the first output. Default: "GUILDAorigin".

outputs.name: result
outputs.purpose: Trajectories: ResultODE (Format "GUILDAorigin"; result.odeResults) or a struct that mirrors the model hierarchy, with tables (Format "struct").

outputs.name: flag
outputs.purpose: 1 completed, 0 stopped by TimeLimit, -1 stopped by the solver.

outputs.name: output
outputs.purpose: Details: message, tEnd, phases, nPhases, nPhasesDone, isSparse, exception.
